description: This file manages session storage, including loading, saving, locking, maintenance, and related utilities for session data in a server environment.

methods.name: loadSessionArchiveRuntime
methods.description: Lazily loads the session archive runtime module.

methods.name: removeThreadFromDeliveryContext
methods.description: Removes the threadId from a DeliveryContext object if present.

methods.name: normalizeStoreSessionKey
methods.description: Normalizes a session key by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: resolveSessionStoreEntry
methods.description: Resolves a session store entry by session key, handling legacy keys and returning normalized key and existing entry.

methods.name: setSessionWriteLockAcquirerForTests
methods.description: Sets a custom session write lock acquirer for testing.

methods.name: resetSessionStoreLockRuntimeForTests
methods.description: Resets the session store lock runtime for testing.

methods.name: withSessionStoreLockForTest
methods.description: Executes a function within a session store lock for testing purposes.

methods.name: readSessionUpdatedAt
methods.description: Reads the 'updatedAt' timestamp of a session key from the store.

methods.name: capEntryCount
methods.description: Caps the number of session entries in the store.

methods.name: getActiveSessionMaintenanceWarning
methods.description: Generates a warning if session maintenance would evict the active session.

methods.name: pruneStaleEntries
methods.description: Removes stale session entries based on pruneAfterMs.

methods.name: resolveMaintenanceConfig
methods.description: Resolves the current maintenance configuration.

methods.name: rotateSessionFile
methods.description: Rotates the session file if it exceeds size limits.

methods.name: updateSessionStoreWriteCaches
methods.description: Updates in-memory caches after writing session store data.

methods.name: resolveMutableSessionStoreKey
methods.description: Resolves a mutable session key in the store, considering normalization.

methods.name: collectAcpMetadataSnapshot
methods.description: Collects a snapshot of ACP metadata from the store.

methods.name: preserveExistingAcpMetadata
methods.description: Preserves ACP metadata from previous entries into the new store, unless explicitly dropped.

methods.name: saveSessionStoreUnlocked
methods.description: Saves the session store to disk, performing maintenance, pruning, capping, and rotation as needed.

methods.name: saveSessionStore
methods.description: Saves the session store with lock acquisition.

methods.name: updateSessionStore
methods.description: Updates the session store atomically with a mutator function.

methods.name: recordSessionMetaFromInbound
methods.description: Records session metadata from inbound message context.

methods.name: updateLastRoute
methods.description: Updates the last route information in a session entry.

methods.name: lockTimeoutError
methods.description: Creates an error indicating a lock timeout.

methods.name: resolveSessionStoreLockMaxHoldMs
methods.description: Calculates maximum hold time for session store lock based on timeout.

methods.name: getOrCreateLockQueue
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a lock queue for a given store path.

methods.name: drainSessionStoreLockQueue
methods.description: Drains the lock queue, executing pending lock tasks.

methods.name: withSessionStoreLock
methods.description: Executes a function within a session store lock, handling lock acquisition and release.

methods.name: updateSessionStoreEntry
methods.description: Updates a specific session entry atomically within a lock.
